predicate_proof: For exp=0, |obs-exp|=|obs|=|-obs|, while tolerance=1e-9*max(0,scale) is unchanged. This uses actual predicate source, not spelling alone.
zero_encoding: Wide::neg flips sign; recover::publish_value canonicalizes any exact zero to Normal(+0.0). No exact computed reaction values are claimed from aggregate logs.
other_observables: Selected cases and unchanged stored records are observed in existing P35. Stored records do not serialize each reaction value; record equality alone does not prove all internal reactions exactly zero.
